title: PM Narendra Modi urges industry to put India First in long-term investment decisions

ai.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged Indian industry to prioritize national interests in long-term investments during a FICCI centenary event, highlighting economic progress and the need to reduce import dependence in key sectors.

facts.claim: Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged Indian industry to put India First at the centre of its long-term investment decisions
facts.quote: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Thursday urged Indian industry to put India First at the centre of its long-term investment decisions

facts.claim: The next 20 years would be crucial for the country’s journey towards becoming a developed and self-reliant nation
facts.quote: saying the next 20 years would be crucial for the country’s journey towards becoming a developed and self-reliant nation

facts.claim: India is today the world’s fastest-growing major economy
facts.quote: PM Modi said India was today the world’s fastest-growing major economy

facts.claim: Merchandise exports touched nearly $50 billion in October, the highest monthly figure ever
facts.quote: he said merchandise exports touched nearly $50 billion in October, the highest monthly figure ever

facts.claim: The basic corporate tax rate had been reduced from 30 per cent to 22 per cent
facts.quote: he said the basic corporate tax rate had been reduced from 30 per cent to 22 per cent

facts.claim: India exported iron ore but imported finished steel
facts.quote: he pointed out that India exported iron ore but imported finished steel

ai.background_note: PM Modi emphasized economic reforms and reduced import dependence in critical sectors during a FICCI centenary address.
